csv_project_name: AE Services for Highway Facility Modifications & Relocation
csv_scope_of_work: Winnebago County desires to secure the professional services of an architectural/engineering consultant to develop a two-part detailed design, bid documents, construction documents and contract administration for shop modifications located at the Highway Facility and for the relocation of the Facilities Department to the Highway Facility Campus. These projects are identified in the Master Planning Study Report. This project consists of two parts. The first part is the upgrades and modifications to the Highway Department Building. The second part is to construct a new Facilities Department Building and relocate all the functions of the Facilities Department from its current home on Knapp Street to the parcel shared by the Highway Department. The Winnebago County Highway Department is located on a County owned parcel on the Southwest corner of the intersection of Hwy 76 (Jackson St) and Cty Hwy Y. The parcel is also home to the Sheriff's Office Campus, two Evidence/Storage Building, the Medical Examiner's Office Building, the Solid Waste Transfer Station and the 980 Residential Facility.
csv_disciplines_requested: Architecture Services, Geotechnical Engineering, Soil Testing, Land Use Planning, Planning/Master Planning, Redevelopment Planning, Waste Management, Stormwater, Urban Studies/Planning/Design
